name: lint_all
description: Run lint_python (ruff), lint_svelte (svelte-check + eslint), lint_rust (clippy), and wylde_check (custom architectural rules) and consolidate findings. Returns a single envelope with the union of all findings.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: List of sub-tools to skip (any of 'python', 'svelte', 'rust', 'wylde_check').
